title: quality-focal soft-target loss for the node validity (child validity nu) in a 4 u fine-tune of the fast variant j1 192 / 96

a.recipe: p16_train.py --design D7 --init e123_D7_r3_j1 --u 4 --lr 0.0005 --stem_lr 0.3 --warm_frac 0.4 --set <j1 config as _run_j1eq.sh> --w rec=1.0 qfl_beta=2 qfl_sigma=0.5 ; seeds 0 and 1

b.recipe: as a with qfl_beta=0 (soft BCE on the continuous target, proper scoring rule)

c.recipe: existing equal-budget control e18_D7_j1eq / e18_D7_j1eqs1 (hard labels, recall weight 1); same tau as the control of E244

rule.note: lower is better; node-validity ECE, 10 bins, hit = within 1 m of a lane (E221 definition)

kill: toy test fails; < 20 % of rejected far hits lie in (0.6, 1.0] m; after 1 u val250 Q more than 0.02 below j1 or validity collapses; after both seeds Q of a below c - 0.010 or ECE worse than c
